title: SNL Season 52 Kicks Off Tonight with NBA Champ Jalen Brunson and KATSEYE
summary:
Saturday Night Live is back for its 52nd season tonight, September 26, 2026 — and the premiere is bringing some serious star power.

Hosting the season opener is Jalen Brunson, point guard for the New York Knicks. He's fresh off leading his team to an NBA championship earlier this year. It's a bit unusual for an athlete to host the premiere rather than a later episode, but since Brunson represents a big win for New York City — where SNL is filmed — it fits.

The musical guest is KATSEYE, a global girl group whose members come from the Philippines, South Korea, Switzerland, and the United States. However, as of August 2026, two members — Manon and Sophia — announced they're taking a hiatus to focus on their mental health. It's unclear if they'll return for the SNL performance.

There are cast changes, too. Chloe Fineman left over the summer, and Bowen Yang departed mid-season last year. Returning repertory players include Kenan Thompson, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Mikey Day, Sarah Sherman, and Marcello Hernández. Ashley Padilla and Jane Wickline have been promoted from featured players. New faces Saidah Belo-Osagie and Grace Reiter are making their debut.

SNL is famous for being produced in just one week — cast and crew write, rehearse, and perform each episode in a frantic sprint. "SNL is a miracle every time it happens," the article notes.

Next week, October 3, Dakota Johnson hosts with musical guest Turnstile, the Grammy-winning rock band. Johnson is hosting for the third time, promoting her new movie "Verity."

You can watch SNL live at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. Sketches hit YouTube shortly after, and full episodes stream on Peacock the next day. So whether you're a Knicks fan, a KATSEYE fan, or just here for the sketches, this season premiere has something for you.
why_it_matters: SNL is a half-century-old institution that survives by constantly replacing its own cast, so this season's mix of rookies, promoted players and departing stars is a test of whether it can stay culturally relevant; at the same time, KATSEYE's missing members show how debates about young performers' mental health are now part of mainstream entertainment news.

background_read: Saturday Night Live has been on the air since 1975 and is one of the longest-running comedy shows in American television. It is filmed in Studio 8H at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in New York City and was created by Lorne Michaels, who still runs it, and its one-week cycle — writing, rehearsing and performing an episode in about six days — is famous in the industry.

Jalen Brunson is the point guard for the New York Knicks, and athletes have hosted the show before: Michael Jordan and Peyton Manning are among the sports stars who have taken the stage, usually after a championship or a breakout season made them culturally prominent.

KATSEYE is a global girl group assembled through a televised audition programme backed by the Korean entertainment company HYBE (the label behind BTS) and the American label Geffen Records. In recent years several pop and K-pop performers have paused work to protect their mental health, and fans increasingly debate how much pressure young idols should face.
Peacock is NBC's streaming service, which is where SNL episodes appear the day after they air.

perspectives.perspective: Positive — fans of sports, music and comedy (positive)
perspectives.description: Pairing a New York basketball champion with a globally assembled girl group gives the premiere two very different audiences to chase, and the promoted cast members finally get a chance to define themselves. It also keeps a live, one-week production alive at a time when most comedy is pre-recorded.

perspectives.perspective: Critical — questions about the format and the guests (negative)
perspectives.description: KATSEYE performing without two of its members may disappoint fans expecting the full group, and reality-show-style audition groups raise questions about how much control young performers have over their schedules. Cast turnover on this scale also means the show partly rebuilds itself every year, which can weaken its identity.

perspectives.perspective: Analytical — how SNL has always worked (neutral)
perspectives.description: SNL has reinvented itself through cast changes since 1975, and premiere bookings are strategic: a locally popular star plus a trending musical act is a standard ratings play. Its one-week production cycle is both its greatest strength and the reason its quality swings so wildly.

The newcomers hired this season could shape the show for years, while YouTube clips and next-day streaming now reach more people than the live broadcast. How KATSEYE handles a member hiatus will also signal how much the pop industry is willing to slow down for performers' wellbeing.
